attackers_goals: Extracting and decrypting stored Azure AD and Active Directory credentials from Azure AD Connect servers.
description: The AD Sync credential files were accessed in an unusual way.
investigative_actions: See whether this was a legitimate action. Follow the causality chain/user/host activities. Follow unusual actions of the AD Sync user. Check for remote SMB connections to the agent. Check for unusual Azure AD authentications. Check if this happened on other endpoints. Check for unusual logins.
name: Unusual access to the AD Sync credential files
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
